blurb: Golf Dorval is a public golf course open to everyone near Montreal. They offer 18-hole and 9-hole golf rounds with various rates depending on time and day. Miniature golf (Mini-Putt) is also available with separate rates. Golf lessons are offered individually and in groups, including indoor winter lessons at a separate location.
extraNote: No reservations for miniature golf (Mini-putt) · Reservations for golf tee times can be made online starting 3 days before or by phone 9am to 3pm · New reservation system requires all player names in booking from July 3, 2026
